title: Whole Paired Raised Cabins And Overstreet Link
description: One static architectural connection scene, one scene and zero new independent models. Two entire original raised window-cabin towers retain their full returning stairs, platforms, braced posts, roofs and original PBR at unit scale. One whole instance is turned exactly180 degrees; no mesh is cut or rail removed. A newly authored elevated deck connects the two genuinely unrailed outer landing edges at their shared level, with two complete guard sides, underside girders and four grounded supports. A distinct lower pale lane passes beneath the middle of that span, leaving visible above/below circulation layers rather than a single-plane rearrangement. Both entire old tower stair envelopes remain outside the central lane. Unlike the old watch/rest court there are no gabion threshold or resting cot; unlike the slatted shade court, the upper link is a distinct occupied-looking floor between whole elevated cabins, not just overhead roof shading. Empty fixed artistic layout only. No people, load path validation, structural or building-code design, route navigation, human access, egress, surveillance, defensive or safety performance. No rigging animation or interaction made.
